notes: Auto RePost bara fix (Android + Desktop): (1) Downloader tayyar hone se pehle jo video galti se 'skip' ho gayi thi (Pearl Harbor wali), wo khud wapas line mein aa jayegi aur agli check mein post hogi — ab downloader ke tayyar hone ka intezaar hota hai, na-ready par koi video skip nahi hoti. (2) Error messages ab asal wajah dikhayengi (lambi Python traceback ki pehli line nahi). Android par kharab downloader update khud pehchan kar purana version wapas laga diya jata hai. (3) Naya: Fixed Time — har watch ke liye roz ke fixed auqaat (1-3) chun sakte hain, masalan roz 4:30 PM par ek video; ya purana waqfa (interval) bhi maujood hai.
